illustration.prompt: Landscape editorial illustration, fine black pen contours on pure white paper, very sparse grey hatching, no colour, sepia, wash or text. A single ordinary adult in plain shirt and trousers stands hesitating at a short forked village lane. The two lanes each lead to a separate modest veranda: a few empty chairs on both verandas, and small groups in ordinary sari or shirts walking away from each gathering in opposite directions. The central person holds a folded blank invitation in each relaxed hand, looking rueful as both gatherings have ended. Simple believable contemporary Odisha-inspired surroundings, unobtrusive trees and low walls; varied adults, no ceremonial clothing, no named building. Clear visual separation of paths and groups; physically coherent hands and feet. This is a contemporary imagined analogy for postponing a choice and missing both occasions, not a historical origin scene. No clocks, written invitations, signs or speech bubbles.
illustration.caption: An imagined scene: delaying a choice, missing both gatherings.
illustration.alt: A hesitant person at a forked lane holds two blank invitations while people leave gatherings on both sides.
illustration.meaning_invariant: Show unsuccessful preservation of both opportunities, not successful balance or friendship versus wealth as an invented original incident.
review_checks: Both gatherings visibly finished rather than available future options.
One central person, coherent hands holding two separate papers.
No text, colour or religious/historical specificity.

illustration.prompt: Landscape fine black pen editorial line drawing on pure white paper, extremely sparse light-grey hatching, no colour, wash or sepia. One ordinary shaggy bear in a calm natural three-quarter standing pose on all four paws, with a few individual fur strands and modest visible claws on the near forepaw. Natural believable bear anatomy, normal muzzle, rounded ears, properly connected legs. A small ground line and a few plain grasses only, generous white space. The animal is simply a bear: absolutely no human robes, ritual objects, prayer beads, sacred markings, human face, human posture or religious figure. Avoid dramatic growling, threatening teeth or exaggerated claws. The visual accompanies a rhetorical question about outward features not producing spiritual practice; it does not portray or ridicule a real practitioner. No text or symbols.
illustration.caption: Hair and claws do not make a yogi.
illustration.alt: A calm shaggy bear stands on four paws, its fur and ordinary claws lightly outlined.
illustration.meaning_invariant: Keep the ordinary bear image and rhetorical difference between appearance and practice; no human religious caricature or implied animal spiritual behaviour.
review_checks: All four legs and paws plausibly connected.
No anthropomorphic dress, spiritual props or invented historical scene.
Black linework and light hatching only; bear remains legible without filled-black mass.
